question: In recovered official New York City Council hearing transcripts, where did DCLA Commissioner Tom Finkelpearl refer to NYC Artist Coalition?

scope.committee: New York City Council Committee on Cultural Affairs, Libraries and International Intergroup Relations
scope.route: Official committee meeting pages to linked Legistar matter pages to attachments labeled Hearing Transcript
scope.scopeNote: This is a complete search of the official transcript attachments recovered through the declared committee route, not every Council committee, every possible matter route, video, written testimony, or unrecovered record.

method: Recovered official committee meeting pages and their linked Legistar matter pages.
Downloaded every attachment labeled Hearing Transcript reached through that route.
Converted the PDFs to searchable text and searched spelling and name variants.
Deduplicated attachments by SHA-256 and read every candidate passage for speaker attribution and referent boundaries.

commissionerOccurrence.hearing: Executive Budget Hearings - Cultural Affairs, Libraries and International Intergroup Relations
commissionerOccurrence.speaker: DCLA Commissioner Tom Finkelpearl
commissionerOccurrence.locator: Official transcript pp. 91-92; printed transcript p. 92, lines 7-24
commissionerOccurrence.shortQuote: The NYC Artist Coalition formed after we hosted a meeting for DIY Arts Community this past January.
commissionerOccurrence.context: Finkelpearl was explaining CreateNYC as a close reciprocal relationship with the public, DCLA's desire to expand direct public feedback, and the power of bringing people together around a common cause.

nonCommissionerCandidate.hearing: Preliminary Budget Hearing - Cultural Affairs, Libraries and International Intergroup Relations
nonCommissionerCandidate.speaker: Jamie Burkart
nonCommissionerCandidate.classification: keyword candidate classified as not another Finkelpearl reference because Jamie, not Finkelpearl, was the speaker
nonCommissionerCandidate.relevance: Jamie's testimony publicly described CreateNYC office hours as helping underground artists reach safety services and helping the City understand artists' lives.

duplicateOfficialRoute.note: The joint hearing also appears under a Libraries matter as a byte-identical official attachment. It is the same hearing and occurrence, not a second substantive reference.

negativeControls.text: It has had a huge influence both on the plan itself and our thinking related disability arts within the agency.
negativeControls.reason: The immediately preceding subject is the Disability Arts NYC task force formed around the plan; the following words specify disability arts.

findings: One recovered official Council transcript contains a substantive Finkelpearl reference to NYC Artist Coalition: May 19, 2017.
A second candidate transcript from March 16, 2018 contains both names, but the coalition reference is Jamie Burkart's testimony and is not another Finkelpearl reference.
The May 19 joint hearing survives through two byte-identical official attachment routes and counts as one occurrence.

The transcript supports Finkelpearl's public selection of coalition formation as an example within a reciprocal public-engagement explanation; it does not establish private motive or institutional dependency.
limitations: The recovered route is not exhaustive across all Council committees, written submissions, videos, non-transcript attachments, or records unavailable through the declared route.
Keyword counts do not establish who spoke; candidate passages required manual speaker attribution.
No additional commissioner-attributed occurrence surfaced in this recovered corpus, which is not equivalent to proof that no other reference ever existed.
The record supports public institutional function, not private motive, exclusive reliance, sole causation, or legislative authorship.
